description: Renders select, radio, multiple-choice, and checkbox signing steps.

parameters.name: AnonymousCheckbox
parameters.description: Whether the input controls are disabled.

parameters.name: AppearsOn
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the value changes.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Fallback culture used when localized text is missing.

parameters.name: Culture
parameters.description: Whether a single checkbox should show a generic instruction instead of the field label.

parameters.name: Disabled
parameters.description: Short text describing where the field appears in the document.

parameters.name: FallbackCulture
parameters.description: Culture used to resolve localized field and option text.

parameters.name: Fields
parameters.description: Primary signing field represented by this step.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: Optional checkbox fields rendered as one grouped checkbox step.

parameters.name: ValueChanged
parameters.description: Current value. Select/radio use string, multiple and grouped checkboxes use string arrays, checkbox uses bool.
